pitch.headline: Full-Transparency Commercial Real Estate Investing, Powered by AI
pitch.sub: Every deal. Every document. Every metric. From sourcing to close — see exactly what we see. The Terminal gives investors direct access to our entire acquisition pipeline with complete transparency, so you can make informed decisions on your own timeline.

terminal.what_is: The Terminal is not a product. It is the entire technology and operations ecosystem of RePrime Group — every system, workflow, AI tool, data pipeline, and investor-facing interface, unified under one institutional platform. Behind what investors see is a machine running 24/7: multi-model AI pipelines analyzing every deal through Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and Perplexity in parallel; hundreds of automated workflows; a nationwide property-monitoring network covering 3,100+ counties; a tenant-risk intelligence engine; and lending partnerships returning debt quotes in minutes.

value_props.d: The Marketplace and official Terminal — live deal pipeline, full documentation, AI-generated analysis, investment options, and real-time updates. Complete transparency into every active deal.

Multi-model AI (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Perplexity) in parallel. Hundreds of automated workflows. Nationwide property scraping. Tenant-risk scoring. 50-page lease analysis in minutes. Lending quotes in 10 minutes.

Faster decisions. Better data. Full transparency. Deals analyzed and underwritten before most buyers have opened the email. Five closing methods — the ability to move at the speed this market demands.

opportunity.title: The $2.2 Trillion Maturity Wall
opportunity.intro: Between 2024 and 2027, $2.2 trillion in commercial real estate loans are contractually set to mature — the largest refinancing challenge in history. January 1, 2026 marks the end of “extend and pretend”: mandatory mark-to-market, quarterly reappraisals, and the elimination of interest-only modifications will force banks to recognize losses they’ve deferred for years.

process.d: Decades of direct broker, owner, and operator relationships plus AI scanning every major listing platform and 3,100+ counties every 24 hours for auctions, foreclosures, bank REOs, and tax-deed sales.

First-pass underwriting: rent roll, T-12, comps, condition. AI analyzes every offering memo on arrival and 50-page leases in 3–5 minutes, with tenant intelligence and foot-traffic analytics. ~90% of deals are eliminated here.

RePrime personally leads negotiation to lock pricing below market — leveraging timing, certainty of close, and 30 years of reputation. Agreed deals enter the Marketplace for early investor visibility.
The moment a deal goes under contract it appears in the Terminal — purchase agreement, financial models, market reports, tenant analysis, all visible to qualified investors in real-time.
Physical inspection, environmental review, lease audit, tenant interviews, market validation, and final underwriting — every finding uploaded to the Terminal as it's discovered.
Investors fund commitments, the deal closes, title transfers. Whether a direct acquisition or a GP/LP partnership, every detail is documented and retained in the Terminal.
After close the Terminal becomes the investor's window into the asset — monthly financials, occupancy, leasing, capital improvements, and distributions posted as they occur. No quarterly surprises.

paths.name: Direct Acquisition
paths.d: You purchase the property outright through an assignment structure. RePrime sources, negotiates, and underwrites; once under contract we assign the purchase agreement to you. You take title, you own the asset, you control the outcome.

paths.name: GP / LP Partnership
paths.d: RePrime serves as sole General Partner and manages every aspect — acquisition, financing, asset management, disposition. You invest alongside other qualified investors, receive quarterly distributions, and retain full Terminal transparency without the operational burden.

team.name: Shirel Ben Harroush

faq.a: RePrime Group acquires commercial real estate across all asset classes and market conditions, with capital deployed across 800+ transactions and 21M+ square feet nationwide. The firm runs a vertically integrated platform spanning acquisitions, development, construction oversight, asset management, capital structuring, and portfolio optimization.

Our investor base includes high-net-worth individuals, family offices, and institutional partners actively allocating capital throughout the United States. Qualified Israeli investors are served through RePrime Pro using a proven U.S. methodology.

Five closing speeds, from a 7-day hard-deposit close to full institutional terms over 60–90+ days. Deposits are held at First American Title. Every broker submission is evaluated by all five buyer groups independently.

faq.q: How do brokers submit a deal?
faq.a: One submission at broker.reprimeterminal.com takes under three minutes and is evaluated by multiple buyer groups. Commissions are protected on every transaction, and brokers receive free institutional-grade market intelligence on every submission.

A proprietary operating platform built in-house — the investor portal, broker submission portal, deal analysis engine, financial modeling infrastructure, and automated communications, with AI-powered tools across every stage of the investment lifecycle.
Non-refundable deposits are standard where applicable. RePrime closings are not subject to financing, with no retrades and no renegotiation — certainty of close is a core principle.
Through RePrime Pro (reprimepro.co.il) — qualified Israeli investors gain access to the firm's proven U.S. methodology, supported by Herzog, BDO, CLA, and KPMG.
